Attached: 1 image

A full calendar isn't multitasking. Two unfinished jobs that both need you at the same moment is.

A busy day needs fewer things on it. Real multitasking needs one job finished or parked.

Feeling scattered? Take 90 seconds: write down the two unfinished things you're doing right now. Named two? Finish one and give the other a set time later. Only one? Close everything else and keep going.

The kettle doesn't count. A chat reply mid-paragraph does.

#productivity #focus
